newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius sells $59.25 million of T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius sells $59.25 million of T-bills.

text.p: The Bank of Mauritius sold all of the 1,200 million rupees ($59.25 million) of T-bills it put on tender for sale on Thursday, the central bank said.

The central bank said it sold 439.8 million rupees of 91-day, 333.0 million rupees of 182-day and 427.2 million rupees of 364-day bills with average weighted yields of 10.28 percent, 10.60 77percent and 10.62 percent respectively.
This week's effective bank rate was posted at 10.49 percent per annum from 10.57 percent last week, the bank said.

Last week, the Bank of Mauritius sold 850 million rupees of 91, 182 and 364 day Treasury Bills with weighted yields of 10.12 percent, 10.76 percent and 10.83 percent respectively. ($1=20.2525 Mauritian rupees).
